title: China stocks surge most in two years as Beijing vows stronger market support
paragraphs: China stocks surge most in two years as Beijing vows stronger market support
China’s benchmark stock indexes jumped about 4 per cent, posting their biggest daily gains in more than two years after Beijing signalled stronger support for the market.

SHANGHAI: China's share benchmarks jumped 4 per cent and the yuan rose on Friday (Nov 27), after Premier Li Qiang chaired a State Council meeting that called for a bigger role by "national team" investors to stabilise a falling stock market.
